title: Enforcement error response v1
description: Every non-success reply from the enforcement API. The executor maps 'error' onto mark_failed payloads; codes are a closed vocabulary — a new code is a contract change, made in its own PR.

details.description: Machine-readable context. For invalid_target, details.reason is one of: missing_ip, unparseable_ip, loopback, multicast, unspecified, broadcast, link_local, missing_pid, bad_pid, bad_port, port_not_allowed, ip_not_allowed, pid_not_allowed.
